svg.title: Administrative divisions of Irad
svg.desc: The five districts and three cities of the ISEZ and the six UN planning zones of the Autonomous Tribal Regions, with the Qara-Chik Demarcation Line. Base map: Natural Earth (public domain).
svg.text: Talas, Nurzhan and Iyık Janyl are cities of governorate significance, outside the districts.
